skills.description:
Smartphone user persona analyst powered by the Jobs to be Done (JTBD) framework.
Covers 8 user persona types with demographic profiles, behavior patterns, and core needs;
9 major usage scenario categories with 26 sub-categories drilled to 3 levels;
hardware and software preference matrices across processors, cameras, displays, batteries,
OS, AI, and security; 13 cited academic studies and industry reports; and a cross-framework
comparison with vivo's "Phone Personality" model. This skill should be used when users ask
about smartphone user segmentation, consumer behavior analysis, mobile phone usage patterns,
JTBD-based persona analysis, mobile device purchase drivers, smartphone hardware/software
feature preferences by user type, or competitive user persona mapping for mobile devices.
